meta.description: Azure VM/VMSS router. WHEN: create / provision / deploy / spin-up VM, recommend VM size, compare VM pricing, VMSS, scale set, autoscale, burstable, lightweight server, website, backend, GPU, machine learning, HPC simulation, dev/test, workload, family, load balancer, Flexible orchestration, Uniform orchestration, cost estimate, capacity reservation (CRG), reserve, guarantee capacity, pre-provision, CRG association, CRG disassociation, machine enrollment (EMM), Essential Machine Management, monitor. counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 Azure 云上自动创建、配置和管理虚拟机
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要管理 Azure 上的虚拟机集群
copy.tagline_en: Provision and manage Azure virtual machines and scale sets automatically.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Azure virtual machine clusters.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 Azure 虚拟机与规模集(VMSS)的请求先判断意图,再路由到对应工作流:选型推荐、创建部署、容量预留、机器入册管理,之后只加载该工作流要求的参考文件。
howto.when: 当你提到创建/部署 VM、推荐或比较机型价格、VMSS 等关键词,或提出容量预留(CRG)、机器入册(EMM)相关需求时触发;意图不清时它会先反问确认。

say.text: 帮我推荐一台跑机器学习的 Azure 虚拟机规格
say.note: 进入选型推荐工作流,给出机型与价格对比

say.text: 创建一台给网站后端用的虚拟机
say.note: 进入 VM Creator 工作流,只搭裸机基础设施

say.text: 我要预留一批 VM 容量,保证能开出来
say.note: 进入容量预留工作流,处理 CRG 创建与关联

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude classifies Azure VM and VMSS requests by intent and routes them to the matching workflow: recommender, creator, capacity reservation, or machine management, then loads only the reference files that workflow asks for.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention creating or deploying a VM, recommending or pricing VM sizes, VMSS, or ask about capacity reservation (CRG) or machine enrollment (EMM); it asks a clarifying question if intent is unclear.

say_en.text: Recommend an Azure VM size for machine learning work
say_en.note: Routes to the VM Recommender workflow for size and price comparison

say_en.text: Create a VM for my website backend
say_en.note: Routes to VM Creator, building bare VM infrastructure only

say_en.text: Reserve VM capacity so I can always spin it up
say_en.note: Routes to the capacity reservation workflow for CRG create and association
